To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) ALCL developed in a patient who had been treated with immunosuppressive agents for a long time; (2) this patient showed a high level of serum IL‐6 before treatment; (3) this high level of IL‐6 may be related to the pathogenesis of ALCL; and (4) the high level of serum VEGF may also be related to the inflammatory status of the patient.

the patient with ALCL who had been treated with immunosuppressive agents for Evans syndrome for a long time had severe inflammatory symptoms and showed up‐regulation in serum IL‐6 levels and VEGF levels, and that these inflammatory symptoms and serum cytokine levels improved after the treatment of ALCL.
